note: v9 (2026-08-28, multi-brand plan Phase 1): every module, band, known DID, family and decode carries a source {url, date, type, licence}; brands carry read_service, identity_block (layouts name encodings, never brands), platforms[] (vds_pattern regex on VIN 4-10 only where a registry confirmed it), gateway_behaviour, profiled_level and sources[]; modules carry route tuples (protocol, req, resp, target_byte, address_extension, gateway) and per-module read_service overrides; known_dids carry decodes[] (multi-value, signed, be/le/bcd/ascii/bitfield) with the old offset/len/scale/bias kept as a mirror of decodes[0], and are module-bound or marked binding: unknown; the F4xx mode-01 mirror band is low everywhere. See docs/uds/migration-v9.md for every migrated fact and packages/uds-map/COVERAGE.md (generated by pnpm coverage). v8 (2026-08-28) adds the cross-brand ecu_families[] reuse layer (Universal Discovery Protocol L3): decodes keyed by ECU part reference rather than by brand, each carrying knowledge_state, evidence and vehicles_confirmed; seeded from the C4 III ABS (cont_esp_mk100_psa), steering (dae_uds2_psa) and camera (cvm3_psa) fingerprints. known_dids stay unchanged as the backwards-compatible per-brand path. Manufacturer UDS knowledge map: which CAN addresses hold modules, which DID neighbourhoods hold real data, which diagnostic session an exact module may use during automatic discovery, and which DIDs are already identified, keyed by VIN WMI. Researched from primary open-source sources (OVMS, wican-fw, OBDb, CanZE, opendbc, EVNotiPi) plus this project's own verified reads; see docs/uds/uds-map-research.md for per-brand provenance, confidence and gaps. v6 (2026-08-27) adds twelve ABS/ESP (6AD/68D) live-data decodes from the C4 III evidence sessions, each with an evidence note; verified on one vehicle unless stated. Editing this file needs no code change: the discovery engine reads every per-brand value from here. v5 (2026-08-25) adds data-driven generic enumeration policies and standard 29-bit normal-fixed target enumeration while explicitly suppressing generic sweeps for known non-sweepable brands. v4 (2026-08-24) adds opt-in, exact-module discovery session policies; missing policies are default-session only. v3 (2026-08-23) verification+extension pass: re-derived high-confidence PSA/VAG/BMW/Ford/Hyundai/Nissan entries against primary sources directly (found and fixed a Nissan module misattribution, a BMW target-byte error and a wrong DID formula, a VAG module mix-up), fixed a live Renault resp_offset bug for EVC/DCM/BCB/PEB, added newer-model coverage (Mercedes EQB, VAG MEB battery DIDs, Volvo/Polestar CMA platform, Toyota 5th-gen THS), and confirmed Tesla and Mitsubishi are genuinely not OBD-port-UDS-reachable with the specific mechanism documented rather than left a mystery.

standard.note: ISO 14229-1 identification block, genuinely universal, the one part of UDS as standard as OBD PIDs. Kept here rather than in code so every value the engine uses lives in one queryable place.

address_scan.note: Conventional 11-bit physical addressing: request 0x700-0x7F6, response = request + 8. 7DF is the functional broadcast, excluded.
